note: BOOK BACK MATTER, NOT CHAPTER 14 CONTENT. Printed page 520 is the first page of the book's INDEX: the banner heading plus two columns of alphabetical index entries with their page numbers. An index is publishing furniture / back matter and must not be used as chapter-14 passage text; transcribed only because the A2 schema rejects a zero-block page and so the page-coverage check can see the page was accounted for. previous_page_last_block was null, so continuation was judged from my own p051 output, which ended with the GENERAL BOOKS bibliography list complete and the lower half of the page blank; this page opens a new banner heading, so first_block_continues_from_previous is false. Reading order is left column then right column, which is also the order the text layer uses: block n=2 is the left column (Absorption spectra ... Binding energy per nucleon) and block n=3 the right column (Biot-Savart law ... Continuous charge distribution). Each entry's page reference follows its label on the next text-layer line, and the two-reference entry 'Conductivity 97, 468' is kept as printed. The alphabetical index runs on to the next page, so the last block is marked continues_on_next and last_block_continues_on_next is true. No equations, tables or figures on this page.
